summary: Sam Patel contacted HomeNet support due to slow internet speeds experienced throughout the day. The agent initiated a speed test and identified an issue where her connection was being affected by distance from the router. After resetting the line, they offered a Wi-Fi extender at no cost to resolve the problem. Sam expressed gratitude for the service provided.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the standard greeting and offered a post-call survey promptly.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly identified Sam Patel and her account (Sam Patel, account 33190) using her name.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged the customer’s frustration with slow internet ("That's annoying, especially day to day.") and validated their experience (“It is.”).

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a polite tone throughout the conversation, avoiding interruptions and using respectful language. [RoBERTa flagged 1 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s issue in her own words ("Are you connected by wifi or a cable?") to confirm understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed Sam Patel's name and account details with a clear verification process.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked probing questions about connection type (“Can I ask, are you connected by wifi or a cable?”) to understand the root cause of the problem.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent clearly explained the expected resolution (shipping an extender and following up) and provided a timeline for follow-up.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: The agent offered a solution (shipping an extender) that directly addressed the customer’s issue.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: – The agent took responsibility for resolving the problem, stating “I'll ship one at no cost” and assuring her of follow-up.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Sam
